resolution.note: set refuses dropping cleanup entries without --replace; add-cleanup appends

title: krn state set never silently drops cleanup entries
body:
Why: 2026-11-14 the lead ran `krn state set cleanup "[one entry]"` to add one run pointer and silently replaced the 60-entry list, producing 59 orphaned-run errors that the lead had to rebuild by hand.
Outcome: `krn state set` on a list field refuses a value that drops existing entries unless --replace is given, or `krn state add-cleanup <tuple>` appends one entry.
Proof: test on a capsule fixture with two cleanup entries: setting one without --replace exits non-zero naming the dropped pointer; npm run fast PASS.
